text: Cannabis Club in Kata beach Phuket is one of the best shops I’ve been to while staying in Phuket. They are secluded, and we like to call it “The Secret Spot” because it’s located on the second floor of the Aristo Residence. Very knowledgeable and they have good deals. If you come to Kata, give them a visit!
